query:
SELECT ac.name, ac.email, aq.vessel_id, v.name as vessel_name, aq.quota_number, aq.quota_type 
FROM allowed_clients ac 
JOIN allowed_quotas aq ON ac.id = aq.client_id 
JOIN vessels v ON aq.vessel_id = v.id 
LIMIT 5;
